description: This file contains the implementation of the JenkinsHash static class, providing a hash function based on Jenkins hash algorithm for use within the Orleans project. It includes a specific method for computing a hash over a read-only span of bytes, mainly used for data integrity or quick data lookups within the Orleans storage subsystem.

classes.name: JenkinsHash
classes.description: A static class providing a Jenkins hash implementation, specifically designed to compute a hash value for byte data in the Orleans project.

methods.name: Mix
methods.description: A private static method used internally to mix three unsigned integers to produce a good distribution for hash computation.

methods.name: ComputeHash
methods.description: Public static method that computes a Jenkins hash from a ReadOnlySpan<byte> input, processing the data in chunks and applying the Mix function for thorough distribution.
